Abaddon's Handy Candy Cane
Piece:  Weapon
Type:  One-handed Staff
Class:  Mage
Damage:  varies with item level

Abaddon's Handy Candy Cane is a mage one-handed staff.

This item is soulbound.

This rainbow is specific to Abaddon's lair chest. It is not in the shared mythic pool every boss rolls. The Wishing Well can also spit it out once you are high enough for that dungeon. The full list is on Boss Lair Rainbows.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Fire Damage
  • + Ice Damage
  • + Shadow Damage
  • + Defense Rating
  • + Total Mana
  • + Intellect
  • + % Movement Speed

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
